entry.name: jit.gradient
entry.description: Generates a 4-plane char matrix containing a gradient curve that runs along the horizontal axis (i.e. it smoothly fades from left to right). You can select the cell values to fade between as well as Chebyshev coefficients to generate more complex curves and ripples.
